MappingComment: OFC is grouped with frontal cortical samples.
dlPFC is grouped with frontal cortical samples.
Cg25 is treated as medial prefrontal/anterior cingulate cortex for this broad grouping.
Anterior insula is kept as its own broad cortical area by default.
Nucleus accumbens is grouped as ventral striatum/subcortical.
Subiculum is grouped as hippocampal formation / temporal-limbic.
